summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolves attacker-mutable code at install time
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:Cogils/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, the default branch of that repository is fetched and installed, and any lifecycle scripts shipped in the fetched tarball execute with no integrity check or pinning. Because the resolved source is mutable after publication of this package, whoever controls the Cogils/libsignal-node repository at install time controls code that runs on the installer's machine. This is an off-registry, unpinned dependency source — the manifest alone is sufficient to trigger the fetch and execution of whatever the branch currently contains.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
